name: Procedural 3D Worley-Perlin Fractal Noise Density
definition: Synthesizes cloud density $\rho(\mathbf{x})$ procedurally using inverted Worley FBM, vertical gradient attenuation, and coverage thresholding.
summary: Procedural 3D Worley-Perlin Fractal Noise Density generates billowy cumulus clouds by using inverted Worley noise for puffy structures instead of Perlin's smooth gradients.
